pick.headline: Rajiv Gandhi assassinated at Sriperumbudur
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of May 22, 1991, carried Delhi All India Radio in English: Rajiv Gandhi killed by a bomb at an election meeting at Sriperumbudur, possibly remote-controlled, with nine others dead.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 099, 22 May 1991
evidence.snippet: SOUTH ASIA India Former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi Assassinated Details of Assassination BK2205005691 Delhi All India Radio Network in English 0035 GMT 22 May 91 [Text] We regret to announce that the former prime minister and the Congress-I president, Mr. Rajiv Gandhi,…
